name: What types of damage can a roof leak cause besides visible water stains?

mainEntity.name: What types of damage can a roof leak cause besides visible water stains?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond visible water stains, a persistent roof leak can lead to a range of severe and costly problems. These include compromised attic insulation, which reduces your home's energy efficiency; damaged electrical wiring, posing fire hazards; weakened structural components like joists and rafters, risking structural integrity; and the proliferation of mold and mildew in hidden spaces, which can cause respiratory issues and allergies. Undetected leaks can also attract pests and rot wooden elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Besides visible stains, roof leaks can damage insulation and electrical wiring, weaken structural components, and cause mold growth or pest infestations, leading to health and safety risks.
